notes.title: Massive Graphical Update - New Demo Live Now!
notes.notes:
Although there haven't been frequent updates to the Steam page, the development of the game continues steadily and surely.

This is the state of the game during the last Steam update:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761556/4326acf38b7984246931b6b9a1977ab0959bf623.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761556/ca25a9e8b0f318e8e24c3db224d58a30d4c325b5.png

And this is how it looks like in the latest demo build:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761556/bc832813b42067b1ad32073a5a3fc28f14123634.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761556/e01a0ae28e3e9771517fa535cfd24ac71b582c8d.png

As you can see, there have been a lot of advancements in all areas:

Updated roster of models
Re-worked UI
Improved lighting and terrain rendering
Updated editor tools
Bugfixes and stability improvements
Performance improvements
Plenty of quality-of-life touches like progress text during loading screens


The marathon continues and I ain't done just yet. The vision for a truly great RTS is not wholly fleshed out just yet but it's undoubtedly taking steps to get there. Just make sure you've got EVERGLORY in your wishlist so you don't sleep on the final release. In the meanwhile, try out the new demo build and do let me know your feedback!

notes.title: Major Graphics Update
notes.notes:
I continuously keep listening to the community feedback and making improvements in the most important areas based on the feedback that I receive. The gameplay was starting to feel good and the battles were massive and performant, but the cheap look of the terrain rendering was holding the game back. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761556/4dc6988846904c079f8d0a06572b48d93f4f2b64.png

A round of improvements has addressed some of the concerns. Work continues to make the terrain look even better. The changes will be pushed to the demo build when they are done.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761556/9dc50a7fa1058a1f9ca4114ff8cba5bd969f2732.png

Make no mistake, the development of EVERGLORY continues, even if updates on Steam are not daily. Wishlist the game, and subscribe to the devlog on YouTube. 

Big updates are coming soon, so don't miss it!
